changelog: v1.0.4: friendly guidance UX — blocking states now surface as a prominent top banner + popup dialog + disabled buttons instead of console-only lines. Safe access mode shows exact step-by-step switch instructions (module card tuning icon → Full access + Allow background actions) with an in-page re-check button; the manager's misleading 'no shell bridge' refusal is recognized and mapped to the same guidance; dead-bridge state points to manager v14.0.32+ fix; every command failure gets a toast. v1.0.3: dead-bridge degraded mode — some managers' release builds (notably rushiranpise/Shizuku-Next) strip every @JavascriptInterface method via R8 minification, so no module's WebUI can execute commands there. The WebUI now detects this precisely (injected object with zero methods), shows a clear banner instead of raw errors, disables bridge-dependent buttons, and switches to a read-only view rendering state/last-report.json via file:// XHR. check.sh/fix.sh/service.sh persist machine-readable reports every run, so the read-only page always reflects the latest Action-button or boot-recovery result. Module core is unaffected by the manager bug: use the module card's Action button (native path) for check/fix. v1.0.2: universal bridge adapter (sync exec / async ShizukuNext / [diag] fingerprint). v1.0.1: absolute moduleDir paths. v1.0.0: initial release — GMS stopped-state detection & unstop (Android 13+), triple GCM heartbeat, per-boot one-shot auto recovery, target manager, vivo deep links, offline WebUI. Requires Full access + Allow background actions, shell uid 2000 only.
